extra_items.question: Evaluate 42 + 15 − (8 − 7), and 68 − (18 + 13) in two ways.
steps_tex: $68 - (18 + 13)$, way one: the bracket is $31$, so $68 - 31 = 37$.
Way two: open the bracket and change both signs, $68 - 18 - 13 = 50 - 13 = 37$.
Both ways give the same value.

extra_items.text:
$1$. $42 + 15 - (8 - 7)$: the bracket is $8 - 7 = 1$, so $42 + 15 - 1 = 56$.
$2$. $68 - (18 + 13)$, way one: the bracket is $31$, so $68 - 31 = 37$.
$3$. Way two: open the bracket and change both signs, $68 - 18 - 13 = 50 - 13 = 37$.
$4$. Both ways give the same value.
Answer: $56$ and $37$
